title: Davis–Yolo safe repair rehearsal

method.command: scorecard autofix <original.zip> --out <corrected.zip>, then scorecard try <each local zip> --date 2026-07-18 --json-out <receipt.json>
method.scope: Only deterministic whitespace and mixed-case recipes were applied. Accessibility, fares, contacts, service validity, unused shapes, and orphan stops were left unchanged because they require source-owner knowledge or review.

limitations: The corrected copies are local demonstrations, not agency-published feeds and not claimed agency outcomes.
The source sites state no reusable data license, so neither the original nor corrected zip is redistributed here. SHA-256 receipts identify the exact bytes used.
Ad-hoc local scoring has no realtime endpoints. These rehearsal grades therefore exclude realtime and must not be compared directly with a public scorecard that measured it.

agencies.name: Unitrans (ASUCD / City of Davis)
agencies.interpretation: Five certain cleanup changes improved the feed copy without gaming the grade. The highest-impact findings stayed open because filling accessibility fields or deleting unused records without agency knowledge would invent facts or remove data on an assumption.

agencies.name: Yolobus (Yolo County Transportation District)

safe_changes.label: Recase uppercase route names and descriptions

agencies.interpretation: The verified corrected copy cleared 13 of 15 mixed-case notices. Two abbreviated stop names remain for human review. Accessibility, fare, feed-contact, and validity findings remain open because the safe recipes cannot establish those facts.

verification_changed_the_tool.first_attempt: The initial Yolobus corrected copy changed route_long_name values but left all 15 validator notices because the notices were primarily attached to route_desc.
verification_changed_the_tool.repair: The autofix recipe was expanded to cover uppercase route_desc values, then both snapshots were regenerated and rescored.
verification_changed_the_tool.result: The second rehearsal reduced the notice count from 15 to 2 and raised correctness from 90.0 to 92.0.
